mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% signals a tight labor market, leading to wage inflation and subsequent monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 3.5% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% YoY signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO YoY < -2% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 300,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST and RSAFS both increase and 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases > 0.5% in a quarter and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) coupled with an increase in Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) signals a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases and UNRATE increases and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
